# Database connections • 3.13.0

The autocommit parameter arrived in 3.12. Its 3.13 default is LEGACY_TRANSACTION_CONTROL. False is announced as a future default.

DEFERRED is an available legacy isolation level. isolation_level controls implicit transaction opening only under legacy transaction control. With autocommit True, commit does nothing. With False a successful commit of pending work starts a new transaction.

The default wait for a locked table is five seconds, after which OperationalError can be raised. check_same_thread is true by default. Disabling it allows sharing, and callers may need to serialize writes.

3.13 deprecates positional use of connect options including timeout and factory. The documented switch to keyword-only is scheduled for 3.15.

# Delimited text conventions • 3.13.0

None disables escaping. The reader's escape character cancels the special meaning of the next character. Since 3.11 an empty escape character is invalid.

The default writer terminator is CRLF. The reader recognizes CR and LF independently and ignores the configured writer terminator.

QUOTE_NOTNULL quotes every non-None value. None is written as an unquoted empty field, which the reader maps back to None. This mode arrived in 3.12.

When doublequote is true (the default), the writer doubles a quote inside a field. With doubling disabled, it needs an escape character to write such a quote.

QUOTE_STRINGS quotes strings and writes None as an unquoted empty field. The reader maps that field to None and otherwise uses QUOTE_NONNUMERIC behavior.

# Path interpretation • 3.13.0

In 3.13 Path.resolve treats a symlink loop like other resolution errors. Strict resolution raises OSError. Non-strict resolution goes as far as it can and appends the remainder. Older versions raised RuntimeError for loops in either mode.

PurePath.relative_to works lexically. By default it requires the base as a prefix. From 3.12 walk_up can introduce parent segments, but crossing drives still raises ValueError. Resolve links first when necessary.

PurePath.match rejects empty patterns. Relative patterns match from the right. For this method ** acts as one non-recursive wildcard.

# Temporary storage • 3.13.0

NamedTemporaryFile defaults to deletion on close. With delete enabled, turning delete_on_close off can defer deletion until context exit. With delete disabled, delete_on_close is ignored. delete_on_close was added in 3.12.

With a positive size limit a spooled file normally stays in memory until its size exceeds the limit. fileno() and explicit rollover() can each move it to disk earlier.

mkdtemp leaves cleanup to the caller. From 3.12 its result is absolute even for a relative dir argument.

From 3.12 TemporaryDirectory accepts delete=False to disable context-exit cleanup.

# File operations and terminal sizing • 3.13.0

The newer onexc callback receives the raised exception itself as its third argument. The older onerror takes the sys.exc_info() tuple and was deprecated when onexc arrived in 3.12. Exceptions raised by onexc escape the callback.

The rmtree target is a directory rather than a symlink to a directory. From 3.13 missing descendants are ignored. The top-level path is excluded from that FileNotFoundError rule. Exceptions outside the OSError hierarchy always propagate.

Terminal sizing uses positive COLUMNS and LINES overrides for the respective dimensions. A failed terminal query uses fallback, normally 80 columns by 24 lines. From 3.11 a zero returned by the terminal query also uses fallback.

On 3.13 a member and its underlying value can each pass a containment test against the enum class. Before 3.12 a non-member operand raised TypeError.

EnumType is the name used from 3.11. EnumMeta remains available as an alias.

IntEnum members are integers. Integer arithmetic yields a result without enum membership. Since 3.11 the default string conversion uses int's conversion.

StrEnum members are strings. String operations yield ordinary strings, and auto() supplies a lower-case version of the member name. Exact-str type checks can require explicit conversion.

# Path pattern searches • 3.13.0

glob returns a list, which can be empty. Matching broken symlinks are included. Filesystem order can vary and inclusion after a concurrent addition or removal is unspecified.

root_dir selects the search root as if the working directory had been changed. A relative input pattern produces results relative to that root.

In recursive mode ** can span zero or more directory levels. With a trailing separator it does not match files. include_hidden, introduced in 3.11, lets ** match hidden directories.

Several ** segments in a recursive glob can produce duplicate paths.
iglob yields the same matches incrementally.

# Work queue lifecycle • 3.13.0

Queue.shutdown arrived in 3.13. Subsequent puts fail with ShutDown. In its default mode, queued items can still be retrieved until the queue empties. Immediate mode makes gets fail immediately.

join waits on the unfinished task count. Consumers normally call task_done after processing. Immediate shutdown accounts for queued items and can unblock join without a consumer processing them.

After retrieving work, call task_done when processing finishes. Excess completion calls raise ValueError.

qsize is an estimate. A positive observation does not guarantee that the next get will proceed without waiting, nor does apparent spare room guarantee a nonblocking put.

Queue is FIFO. Any nonpositive maxsize denotes no capacity bound. With a positive bound insertion can block at capacity.

# Memoization and instance state • 3.13.0

The pre-3.12 lock was per property. It prevented repeated concurrent getter execution on one instance. From 3.12 concurrent reads can run the getter more than once; callers needing exclusion supply synchronization.

A cached property writes its result to the instance attribute. That attribute takes precedence until deleted, after which another lookup can recompute it.

cached_property needs a mutable instance dictionary and can increase its memory use by interfering with key sharing. Slots without an instance dictionary cannot supply the required storage.

The cache decorator keeps its data structure coherent across threads.
Multiple callers can still execute the wrapped function before the first result is cached.

# Iterator consumption • 3.13.0

batched appeared in 3.12. It consumes just enough inputs for each tuple. In 3.13 strict defaults to False, allowing a short last tuple. Strict mode raises ValueError for that remainder.

A batch size below one raises ValueError. A full batch is yielded before attempting the next batch.

pairwise yields adjacent overlapping pairs. For a nonempty input the number of pairs is one less than its length.

zip_longest fills positions from exhausted inputs with fillvalue, defaulting to None. It runs until the longest input is exhausted.
